rules: Group chosen by field, not by query text.
Primary first, then at most one fallback; corroborateOnly sources may confirm a fact the primary/fallback already has, never add one.
If primary and fallback lack the fact, say nothing.
Third-party predictions, xG, ratings and odds never set our probabilities.
Paid sources are deferred until Xavi says yes.
Scoped search is allowed only inside a group's searchIncludeDomains and only for groups whose access includes a search template; open web search is out of the fact path.
Exception: the odds/market group is aggregate-all, not primary/fallback.

enforcement.groupSelection: Each dossier field maps to exactly one group key below.
enforcement.searchScope: Pass searchIncludeDomains as the include/allowed-domains filter; no LLM rewriting of the query; log the exact query sent.
enforcement.fixtureMatch: An item is accepted only if it carries the fixture ID (pl_match_id / espn / fotmob / goal uuid / bbc tipo id) or its page content names both clubs and the competition and its date fits the window (published after each club's previous match and before kickoff).
enforcement.slotFromContent: The slot is set from the page/feed field (e.g. FPL status, Goal suspensions[]), never from the query that found it.
enforcement.teams: Join clubs by provider team ID, not name regexes (fixes Coventry/Hull/Ipswich misses and 'city'/'united' collisions).
enforcement.freshness: Record fetchedAt and the source timestamp; drop if the source timestamp predates each club's previous match.

fixture_identity.queryTemplate: {home} v {away} {competition} {kickoff_date} (corroborate-only lookup; facts come from structured APIs)
fixture_identity.notes: Resolve once per fixture, by date + both team IDs. PL matchId = FPL fixture code = Opta id; map ESPN, FotMob, Goal match uuid and BBC tipo id onto it. Every other group joins on these IDs.

access.fpl: structured API: fantasy.premierleague.com/api/bootstrap-static/ (status a/d/i/s/u, chance_of_playing_next_round, news, news_added), team by FPL team id
access.club-official: per-fixture content by match ref where the club is on Pulselive (Spurs: api.thfc.pulselive.com/content/thfc/text/EN/?references=SDP_FOOTBALL_MATCH:{pl_match_id}); else sitemap + slug

injuries_doubts.notes: FPL is the only tested source with doubts (%) and fresh timestamps. A club or PL article can confirm an FPL row, never add a player FPL/FotMob don't list.

suspensions.notes: Goal is new as fallback: only source besides FPL that had Bentancur suspended (FotMob missed it).

confirmed_lineups.queryTemplate: {home} v {away} {competition} {kickoff_date} (corroborate-only lookup; facts come from structured APIs)
confirmed_lineups.notes: Only after official release (~T-60m). No predicted XI from anyone.
dropped: predicted lineups (PL 'Predicted line-ups' articles, WhoScored, Goal, FotMob)

access.pl-api: structured API: v3 lineups managers (match day)

manager.queryTemplate: {home} v {away} {competition} {kickoff_date} (corroborate-only lookup; facts come from structured APIs)
manager.notes: Pre-release, use Goal's per-fixture manager (tested: X. Alonso, R. De Zerbi). PL staff list is NOT a fallback: it listed two Chelsea 'Manager' entries.

form_table_h2h.queryTemplate: {home} v {away} {competition} {kickoff_date} (corroborate-only lookup; facts come from structured APIs)
form_table_h2h.notes: Deterministic numbers; no search. If ESPN and fallback disagree on the table, show neither.

access.footystats: per-fixture page: footystats.org/england/{home-slug}-vs-{away-slug}-h2h-stats (season xG/xGA, home/away split, kickoff shown on page)
access.fpl: structured API: sum of player expected_goals by team (Opta via PL); label as 'player xG total'

xg_advanced.notes: Never mix xG models in one line (20 Oct: Chelsea season xG FootyStats ~11.3, Understat 11.92, FPL player sum 9.98). Name the source with the number. Third-party xG never enters our probabilities.
dropped: The Analyst as data source (JS-only, behind Stats Perform key)

access.fpl: structured API: bootstrap-static elements (minutes, goals, assists, expected_goals/assists per 90)

player_stats.notes: No free fallback that passes terms (Understat robots Disallow /; FBref/Sofascore/WhoScored blocked). If FPL lacks it, say nothing.

access.club-official: Spurs: api.thfc.pulselive.com/content/thfc/text/EN/?references=SDP_FOOTBALL_MATCH:{pl_match_id}; Chelsea: chelseafc.com/en/sitemap.xml lastmod + slugs like alonso-press-conference-pre-{opp}-..., confirmed-chelsea-line-up-vs-{opp}-{ddmmyy}

previews_quotes_press.queryTemplate: {home} v {away} {competition} {kickoff_date} press conference team news preview
previews_quotes_press.notes: ID-keyed editorial replaces open search. Reject women's/academy items (Chelsea and Spurs feeds both carry WSL Chelsea v Spurs content). Reject items whose body is about another match even if tagged (PL tagged an Everton-game Chavarria article to Che-Tot).

access.club-official: scoped search / club content API for official announcements

transfers_market_value.notes: Completed deals only from club or PL. Market values: Transfermarkt only, cited as 'Transfermarkt estimate', never scraped at volume. Rumours: say nothing.

access.polymarket: structured API: gamma-api.polymarket.com/events (match by both clubs + date)

odds_market.queryTemplate: {home} v {away} {competition} {kickoff_date} (corroborate-only lookup; facts come from structured APIs)
odds_market.notes: Shown once, separate Consensus view; never set or blend our probabilities. Ignore odds widgets on FootyStats/Goal/CBS (affiliate). Odds licensing still Xavi's call.
odds_market.note: Aggregation group (Xavi 2026-10-20): show EVERY live source's price side by side with timestamps, plus best price and our fair price. No primary/fallback. Add free sources as they're verified; a source that's stale or failing is omitted from the table, never guessed. Market never sets or blends our probabilities. Odds licensing still Xavi's call.

access.football-data: CSV: football-data.co.uk/mmz4281/{yyyy}/E0.csv (results, Pinnacle/B365 closes, now HxG/AxG)

historical_backtest.queryTemplate: {home} v {away} {competition} {kickoff_date} (corroborate-only lookup; facts come from structured APIs)
historical_backtest.notes: Offline only, never in the request path. Respect time order (no future snapshots; the old Elo champion leaked). football-data lags ~1 week (last row 12 Oct on 20 Oct).

pl-api.name: Premier League official API (Pulselive)
pl-api.tos: Undocumented; needs Origin: https://www.premierleague.com; PL site terms restrict reuse. Commercial use unclear.

pl-editorial.name: Premier League editorial content API
pl-editorial.tos: As pl-api. Quote/paraphrase with link; don't republish whole articles.

fpl.name: FPL bootstrap-static + fixtures (PL-run)
fpl.tos: Unofficial public API meant for game use; commercial use unclear (interim).

espn.name: ESPN site API
espn.tos: Undocumented; Disney terms restrict automated extraction. Already in use.

fotmob.name: FotMob
fotmob.tos: robots.txt disallows /api/* for generic agents; data licensed from enetpulse. Weakest terms.

goal.name: Goal.com match page (Perform/Opta-fed __NEXT_DATA__)
goal.tos: robots.txt allows all; site terms (DAZN/Footballco) likely forbid systematic extraction. Treat as per-fixture page read, low volume.

club-official.name: Club official sites (e.g. tottenhamhotspur.com content API, chelseafc.com sitemap+article)
club-official.tos: First-party, but club site terms restrict reuse; quote briefly with link. Per-club access method differs; only Spurs and Chelsea tested.

bbc.name: BBC Sport fixture + live match page
bbc.tos: BBC terms forbid commercial reuse of content; quote briefly with link.

cbs.name: CBS Sports soccer
cbs.tos: Editorial; terms restrict reuse. Many EPL pages are Kalshi-promo betting picks.

footystats.name: FootyStats per-fixture H2H/xG page
footystats.tos: robots.txt only disallows /api/club*; site sells a paid API, so terms may restrict scraping. Low volume, per-fixture page.

statbunker.name: Statbunker
statbunker.note: 8-15 s per page from the box

the-analyst.name: The Analyst (Opta)
the-analyst.tos: Stats pages are JS-rendered from Stats Perform's api.performfeeds.com with an embedded outlet key; using that key is off-limits. Articles only.

understat.name: Understat
understat.tos: robots.txt: User-agent * Disallow / . Backtest/research only, not runtime.

transfermarkt.name: Transfermarkt
transfermarkt.tos: Terms prohibit scraping; injury data lags (missed 3 Spurs injuries 20 Oct).

kalshi.name: Kalshi
kalshi.tos: Public market data API. Odds licensing decision pending with Xavi.

clubelo.name: ClubElo
clubelo.tos: Pinned artifact only; no runtime fetch.
clubelo.note: api.clubelo.com timed out from the box 20 Oct

oddschecker.name: Oddschecker
oddschecker.tos: Affiliate site; terms restrict scraping. Not tested.
